title: pi-arm64-exec (announcement)
brief: A pi extension giving the agent exactly one tool — doing file read/edit work in arm64 assembly — to stop Astra shelling out to python3, ruby and perl for file ops. Announcement; the actual link was promised in a follow-up tweet.
details: An X announcement of pi-arm64-exec, a Pi extension that gives the agent exactly one tool — doing file read/edit work in arm64 assembly — to stop the Astra model shelling out to python3, ruby, and perl for file operations. The idea: give the agent a single fast native tool for file ops instead of letting it reach for interpreted languages. The link is the announcement; the actual repo link was promised in a follow-up tweet, so treat this as a pointer rather than a usable resource.
